app.name: Bonik Bondhu
lang.label: Language
land.tagline: Loans that move with your money
land.sub: Keep your accounts, test a loan against your own cash, and share the proof with a lender. The lender decides.
land.scale_label: A balance: this week's free cash on the left, the weekly installment on the right
land.fits: Fits — {{left}} still in hand each week
land.demo_note: DEMO numbers: a shop with Tk 21,500 free each week, repaying in 12 weekly installments, no fees. Your real check uses your own records, every due date and the cash you want to keep.
land.step1_text: Sales, purchases and loans — typed in or read from a receipt photo.
land.step2_text: Every installment date is checked against your cash, and the app finds schedules that fit.
land.step3_text: You choose what a lender sees; a fingerprint shows nothing was changed.
land.lenders_text: Read a case the owner chose to share, ask for more, and record your own decision.
land.never: Bonik Bondhu does not lend. The lender decides.
